content: {DRAFT} When LdCom_StartOfReception is invoked, LdCom shall use the passed PDU Id as Handle Id (LdComHandleId Specification of Large Data COM AUTOSAR CP R21 - 11 18 of 69 Document ID 655 : AUTOSAR_SWS_LargeDataCOM ECUC_LdCom_00005 ) to derive the corresponding <LdComUser_LdComCbkStartOfReception> user notification callback and call it with the according LdCom user callback handle Id.
